scope: Counts whole registered trials, including pre-model safe stops and unsuccessful repairs.
Raw publications retain their original grades; confirmed semantic regressions are separately reported in the independent audits and final holdout report.
Do not pool repair rates across changing native oracles, contexts, prompts and budgets.
Repeated trials add observations on the same defects; they do not add independent defects.
The24 fixture-authoring prototypes/37calls and16 original four-case smoke trials/21calls are historical evidence outside this formal ledger.
Operations reuse one simple source defect and contribute no additional unique C++ defects.
Native property probes, Python tests, scripted controls, CI and recorded replays contribute zero live model evaluations.
